verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so explaining GPU-to-CPU fallback is a fair question. Nothing in the pack documents diagnostic output explaining why GPU acceleration failed or that it fell back to CPU. Community reports describe silent non-use: on a Pixel the GPU isn't used even when enabled, and Needle 3 doesn't run inference on Apple GPU, with no mention of any message explaining why.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know why GPU acceleration failed and silently fell back to CPU through clear diagnostic output
